[The helper](/home/holden/mckernel-work/host-preparation/native-exec-delivery-transfer-rust-repair-20261021-1/exec_transfer_checked.rs) correctly separates phase1 geometry from phase2 state. Phase2 checks request/key identity, stages no partial malformed plan, rejects physical overlaps, requires descriptor-delivery commit even for all-BSS images, gates pages on reservation success, and advances the strict file-backed page cursor only on matching successful-copy commits.

The evidence supports pure geometry/state acceptance. Mock reservation failure and unchanged-state loops do **not** establish real ledger rollback, queue-full retention, cancellation or mapping lifetime.

Remaining integration predicates:

- Implement the response-owned Rust claim group, including every conflict path and shutdown-quiescence check; retain it through actual response publication or quarantine.
- Add the exact post-FROM_REMOTE-user-copy commit/abort route.
- Gate phase1 RET0 separately on completed validated upload; its current helper is stateless.
- Propagate the launcher’s transfer ioctl failure instead of returning0.
- Obtain actual module/link/default-selection and separately released native evidence without bypassing capacity controls.

[Actual closed evidence](/home/holden/mckernel-work/host-preparation/native-exec-delivery-transfer-rust-repair-20261021-1/actual-pure-checked-state-1/whole.json).
